article.title: Arkansas hosts Tulsa in Week 4
article.story: Tulsa (3-0) at Arkansas (1-2), Sept. 26 at 8 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Arkansas by 8.5. Against the spread: Arkansas 0-3, Tulsa 2-1. How to watch: SEC Network+ Key stats Arkansas Offense Overall: 340 yards per game (110th in FBS) Passing: 264.7 yards per game (45th) Rushing: 75.3 yards per game (135th) Scoring: 19.3 points per game (122nd) Arkansas Defense Overall: 352.7 yards per game (82nd in FBS) Passing: 208 yards per game (74th) Rushing: 144.7 yards per game (87th) Scoring: 34 points per game (122nd) Tulsa Offense Overall: 392.7 yards per game (77th in FBS) Passing: 172.3 yards per game (112th) Rushing: 220.3 yards per game (32nd) Scoring: 29.7 points per game (79th) Tulsa Defense Overall: 342.3 yards per game (72nd in FBS) Passing: 240 yards per game (107th) Rushing: 102.3 yards per game (41st) Scoring: 9 points per game (7th) Tulsa ranks 133rd in third down percentage, converting 24.4% of the time. Arkansas is 119th in the FBS with a -3 turnover margin, compared to Tulsa's 11th-ranked +4 margin. Tulsa leads the FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 28.6% of trips. Tulsa ranks 83rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:38, compared to Arkansas' 30th-ranked average of 32:34. Team leaders Arkansas Passing: K.J. Jackson, 618 yards, 4 TDs, 2 INTs, 60.4 completion percentage Rushing: Braylen Russell, 66 yards on 24 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Chris Marshall, 246 yards on 19 catches, 0 TDs Tulsa Passing: Baylor Hayes, 353 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT, 62.3 completion percentage Rushing: Damari Alston, 186 yards on 36 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Oran Singleton, 163 yards on 9 catches, 2 TDs Last game Arkansas was beaten by Georgia 45-17 on Sept. 19. Jackson threw for 212 yards on 20-of-27 attempts (74.1%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Sutton Smith carried the ball six times for 17 yards and scored one touchdown, adding one reception for 40 yards. Marshall put up 104 yards on seven catches. Tulsa beat East Texas A&M 42-0 on Sept. 19. Dexter Williams II passed for 164 yards on 14-of-26 attempts (53.8%) with three touchdowns and no interceptions. Seth Davis had 90 rushing yards on nine carries and one touchdown. Singleton had two receptions for 38 yards and one touchdown. Next game Arkansas plays at No. 23 Texas A&M on Oct. 3. Tulsa hosts North Texas on Oct. 1.
